It comes down to personal preference, but I end up preferring to do B first because halfway through the mission all those walls go up and usually make it much harder to get to the deposit.

Also I found the mission to be way easier to just duo with a friend and coordinate, with 2 people it only takes 3 deposits to fill each point so you can just have one person take top B and the other do bottom C and then meet at A in the middle.
Was getting sub 4 minute runs this way compared to running with randoms taking 6+ minutes, a weird case of more people makes it go slower if you're not all on the same page.

comments.text:
I believe prioritizing B first is the better strategy, as once you have made some progress the hallways outside the syndicate rooms (which is where B tends to be) tend to get blocked off in inconvenient ways. So you want to get as much of B done as possible before that happens. And then leave A for last as there’s more room there to maneuver around the increased enemies.

Also it seems no Eximus enemies spawn in this mission, only Follie is CC immune so bringing a frame with large crowd control and casting just before picking up any ink may also be a good strategy.

comments.text: How to farm the operation? Run the nightmare mode alerts for the resource. Only go as far with the follie’s hunt for the non-plat purchasable stuff and farm something else during the downtime of the alerts for that plat. None of the specific resources, be it the atramentum or the nightmare taters, are affected by drop chance or double drop resource boosters, so the farming itself is a huge slog. Also, unless they changed it, Adversaries like Kuva Liches can and will steal the operation resource from alerts so deal with them/change their sector location if you can before running the alerts.

comments.text:
while the operation might not “begin” before you touch the Inkwells, Inked enemies might just spawn on their own even before that. They dont always only start spawning after the first “Follie is hunting” prompt.
Another important tip is that atramentum acquired from popping the balloons are squad shared, the ones from drops are not. So while Oxylus might be great for those not wanting to go out of their way for popping those, going about with an weapon like the Coda Bubonico or even its base one and the Enkhaus for their aoe alt fire and unlimited ammo would work just as fine. Anything that is on loot radar that doesnt get destroyed is the medallions for the nightmare tatters.
Also, since the loot not fixed, loot frames like Limbo max cataclysm range, Gyre and Xaku would work wonders to just clean up the map much like its used for Plunder stages in Descendia. You don’t specifically need a sturdy warframe for the mission, if you running on a squad have someone fo the loot while another runs Frost with the avalanche augment and everyone else can deal with them mission objectives and medallion finding.
Another important note that everyone forgets is that the amount of Ink per portrait is scaled up to Squad numbers, clear time is almost always the same regardless of amount because of that. So if you confident, do it solo.
